title: Palomar: A registry of Lean verified mathematics
summary: Palomar is a registry system for cataloging and tracking Lean-verified mathematics, created to organize the growing body of formally proven theorems in the Mathlib library. It provides a centralized database for mathematicians and researchers to discover, reference, and navigate verified mathematical results.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of managing and discovering the rapidly expanding collection of formally verified mathematical theorems in the Lean ecosystem.
why_valuable: Provides crucial infrastructure for the formal mathematics community, enabling easier access to verified proofs and promoting reproducibility and trust in mathematical knowledge.
